results.name: write through the layer: the host row has no plaintext name, content, size or index entry; read decrypts
list decrypts and sorts names; a second write keeps an encrypted version that decrypts; rename/move stay encrypted server-side
locked: /Private lists opaque entries, reads are refused (423), header hidden; tags & host-side compress refused inside
cross-store moves happen in the browser: host file → /Private arrives encrypted (source trashed); /Private → host is an explicit decrypting copy
office on encrypted files: Export .xlsx into /Private (rewritten to export + encrypted write), import from /Private inlined; the bare server refuses the blob
amnesic: VFS writes live in RAM (no row), host files can be hidden but are untouched, moves copy into RAM; wipe forgets everything
amnesic deny-by-default: notes/settings/presets refused with nothing written; state kept in memory; compute endpoints still work; /Private still persists (Tails' Persistent folder)
desktop state: /Private paths are sealed before reaching the host and reopened when unlocked; locked seal never leaks
audit walks /Private on the host and flags anything stored in clear (a planted plaintext file is caught)
